title: Broad Bay Island SUP Adventure in Virginia Beach
includes: Commemorative T-shirt upon completion of the route
Stand-up paddleboard adventure around Broad Bay Island
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
This 4.6-mile SUP adventure around Broad Bay Island is recommended for experienced paddlers due to intermittent currents.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Take on a scenic stand up paddle adventure around Broad Bay Island on this 4.6-mile SUP experience in Virginia Beach. Launching from the Surfrider at Marina Shores, this guided paddle combines exercise, waterfront scenery, and time on the water as you navigate around the island. Designed for experienced paddlers due to intermittent currents and the distance covered, this SUP class style adventure offers the opportunity to build confidence and endurance while exploring Broad Bay by paddleboard.
